messages:
tess_release: Quick ops thread: pushing SDK 4.0 tonight 02:00 UTC. Breaking change: model->runtime binding now prefers capacity-class affinity (gpu_a100 > gpu_h100). We need a safe pin/unpin strategy so we don't accidentally route heterogeneous fleets to incompatible runtimes.

omar_infra: Suggest pin by capacity-class rather than region. We can do: `rbctl runtime pin --capacity-class gpu_h100 --runtime-version v3.1 --ttl 72h --note \"sdk4.0 affinity hold\"` for older fleets.

julia_eng: Is that supported by deploybot? We still have autoscaler that mixes instance types in the same pool sometimes.

deploybot: [deploybot] supports capacity-class pins, but note: mixed pools will respect the stricter pin. It'll block new allocations that don't match.

nate_sre: We should avoid global pins. Propose staged: pin low-density pools (capacity-class: small_vm, gpu_h100_fallback) first for 48h, run smoke, then lift for high-density a100 pools.

zoe_prod: How will this affect customers on Dedicated? Need to update release notes and tenant migration plan. We'll add a warning + opt-out knob.

julia_eng: Also flag: SDK 4.0 introduces a routing header X-REDWOOD-PREFER-CAPACITY. Old runtimes ignore it and may misroute. We need compat shim in runtime v3.1 to read header or pin older runtimes.

omar_infra: Proposed commands: `rbctl runtime pin --capacity-class small_vm --runtime-version v3.1 --ttl 48h --reason \"sdk4 affinity hold - smoke\"` and later `rbctl runtime unpin --capacity-class small_vm --reason \"smoke passed\"`

tess_release: Triggers for unpin: fewer than 0.5% new decode mismatches for 30m AND p99 latency within +200ms baseline AND no 5xx spikes. If any trigger breached, we revert pins to previous state and open rollback ticket.

nate_sre: Add automated telemetry check: if deploybot sees p99 > baseline+300ms for 10m, auto-post slack alert but not auto-pin. Manual pin only.

ojulia_eng: tiny correction: my earlier change requires runtime v3.1+ to accept header; we'll backport small shim to v3.1.1 in case we need rapid fix.

zoe_prod: I pushed a draft note to docs: \"Dedicated customers: contact support to schedule capacity-class migration\". Will link in release notes.

deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled canaries: small_vm -> 02:15 UTC, gpu_h100_fallback -> 02:30 UTC, a100_highdensity -> 03:00 UTC. Canary windows 15m each.

omar_infra: Ops playbook snippet for pin: ```
# pin small fleets
rbctl runtime pin --capacity-class small_vm --runtime-version v3.1 --ttl 48h --reason \"sdk4 safe-rollout\"
```

tess_release: OK locking plan. We'll start with small_vm pin at 01:45 UTC (pre-stage), run canaries, then decide. Manual owners: @tess_release and @nate_sre oncall. Closing unless questions.
